summary: BUG-207 fix VERIFICATION FAILED — CRITICAL. The BUG-207 change in RecipeBulkEditor.jsx introduced a ReferenceError that crashes the entire Bulk view into ErrorBoundary. Root cause: main agent added setPurchaseRates(rateMap) call (L109) and purchaseRates.get(ingId) read (L137) plus dep [purchaseRates] (L151), but FORGOT to declare `const [purchaseRates, setPurchaseRates] = useState(new Map())`. When user clicks [data-testid='recipe-view-bulk'], React throws `ReferenceError: purchaseRates is not defined` at RecipeBulkEditor and ErrorBoundary shows 'Something went wrong'. NONE of V-COST-1, V-COST-2, V-MARGIN-1, V-MARGIN-2, V-ZERO could be verified because the grid never renders. V-SAVE-REGRESSION also blocked (Save button unreachable). Additional secondary bug spotted at L511: unconditional `₹{cost.toFixed(0)}` will TypeError-crash the row when cost is null — precisely the '—' branch this fix is supposed to introduce.

rca of the issue: BUG-207 fix in /app/frontend/src/components/inventory/RecipeBulkEditor.jsx is incomplete. The diff added: (a) getVendorItemList() call to build a lastRate Map (L91-108), (b) setPurchaseRates(rateMap) at L109, (c) purchaseRates.get(ingId) inside costMarginFor at L137, (d) purchaseRates in useCallback deps at L151, and (e) '—' render at L516 for null margin. However, the corresponding `const [purchaseRates, setPurchaseRates] = useState(new Map());` hook declaration was NOT added alongside the other useState declarations (L68-74). Grep confirms: only 3 occurrences of `purchaseRates` in the file — all reads/writes, no declaration. Result: JS reference lookup fails at first render → uncaught ReferenceError → ErrorBoundary shows 'Something went wrong'. Additional latent bug at L511: `₹{cost.toFixed(0)}` needs a null-guard to match the null-cost design (cost is explicitly returned as `null` from costMarginFor when any ingredient lacks a purchase rate; only the margin cell at L513-517 has the null-guard).

action_items: CRITICAL: Add missing `const [purchaseRates, setPurchaseRates] = useState(new Map());` state hook near other useState calls in RecipeBulkEditor.jsx (top of component, around L75). Import useState is already there.

After both fixes, re-run the V-COST/V-MARGIN/V-ZERO/V-SAVE test set. The purchaseRates load is async (~5-8s for vendor-item-list payload of 1,146 records), so test should wait ≥8s after toggling to Bulk view before asserting cost values.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeBulkEditor.jsx: purchaseRates state hook declaration is missing but the variable is referenced in 3 places (L109 write, L137 read, L151 dep). This is a straightforward oversight — the fix diff for BUG-207 must have missed the useState line.

RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L511: The cost cell does NOT null-guard `cost.toFixed(0)`, but costMarginFor explicitly returns `cost: null` for uncovered recipes. This will crash the row even after fixing the ReferenceError above. The margin cell at L513-517 is correctly guarded — mirror that pattern.

MINOR: The purchaseRates Map is loaded async in a separate useEffect (L88-114) independent from the recipes/foodsMaster hydration useEffect. Since costMarginFor recomputes via useCallback deps [priceByName, purchaseRates], the Cost/Margin cells will update automatically once purchaseRates resolves — this is correct, but expect a brief window where all rows show '—' before the vendor-item-list payload arrives. Consider a loading indicator or defer render until purchaseRates is populated.

MINOR: Consider extracting the vendor-item-list fetch + rateMap build into a custom hook (useLastPurchaseRates) — it's ~20 lines of tightly-coupled logic that would be reusable elsewhere (e.g., Sub/Addon views if they also need cost).
